ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
fun cleanText(t) = trim(t default "") replace "\u0000" with ""
var serviceDesc = cleanText(payload.Service_Description) var problemDesc = cleanText(payload.ProblemDesc) var summaryNotes = (payload.app_notes default [] map (note) -> cleanText(note.SummaryNotes)) joinBy " "
var fallback = if(!isEmpty(serviceDesc)) serviceDesc else if(!isEmpty(summaryNotes)) summaryNotes else "HVAC service call"
var materialCtxRaw = [serviceDesc, summaryNotes, problemDesc] filter (!isEmpty($)) joinBy " " var materialCtx = if(!isEmpty(materialCtxRaw)) materialCtxRaw else ((payload.order_materials default [] map $.ITEMDESC) joinBy " ") default "HVAC service call materials"
--- [ { channel: "problem_description", text: if(!isEmpty(problemDesc)) problemDesc else fallback }, { channel: "service_description", text: if(!isEmpty(serviceDesc)) serviceDesc else fallback }, { channel: "summary_notes", text: if(!isEmpty(summaryNotes)) summaryNotes else fallback }, { channel: "material_context", text: if(!isEmpty(materialCtx)) materialCtx else fallback } ]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { inputText: payload.text[0 to 8191] default payload.text, dimensions: 1024, normalize: true }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { channel: vars.queryTexts[vars.counter - 1].channel, vector: "[" ++ (payload.embedding joinBy ",") ++ "]" }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- (payload map $.payload) reduce ((item, acc={}) -> acc ++ { (item.channel): item.vector })

db:select.doc:name: Search Problem Vector
db:select.db:sql: SELECT service_call_id, service_description, summary_notes, material_description, (1 - (problem_description_emb <=> :vec::vector)) AS similarity_score, 'problem_description' as search_channel FROM service_calls WHERE material_description IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(material_description) <> '' AND status = 'Complete' AND service_call_id <> :excludeId AND (:div IS NULL OR divisions = :div) ORDER BY similarity_score DESC LIMIT 10
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ vec: vars.queryVectors.problem_description, excludeId: vars.targetId, div: vars.targetDivision }]
